courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 高層建築核心筒滑模施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「自動爬模的工序與樓層循環」與「早齡強度驗收與爬升放行」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高層建築核心筒滑模施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle" and "Early-age strength acceptance and climbing release" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Slipform construction of high-rise cores must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把整套模板與平台錨固在剛澆好的牆上逐層自爬：錨點強度、油壓爬升、樓層循環與風速管制；高層建築核心筒滑模施工則以讓模板在混凝土初凝時連續上升：滑升速度、出模強度、千斤頂荷重與垂直度控制為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on self-climbing a complete form and platform set storey by storey on freshly cast walls: anchor strength, hydraulic lifting, floor cycles and wind control; Slipform construction of high-rise cores centres on moving forms upward continuously as concrete sets: slip rate, exit strength, jack loads and verticality control, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「樓層循環時程」與「連續滑升工序」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高層建築核心筒滑模施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「出模檢查、早齡強度與成熟度法」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Floor cycle time” and “Continuous slipform cycle”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Slipform construction of high-rise cores, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Exit checks, early-age strength and the maturity method", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 高層建築差異縮短補償
related.transfer: 可遷移「自動爬模的工序與樓層循環」與「早齡強度驗收與爬升放行」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；高層建築差異縮短補償的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Automatic climbing sequence and floor cycle" and "Early-age strength acceptance and climbing release" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦把整套模板與平台錨固在剛澆好的牆上逐層自爬：錨點強度、油壓爬升、樓層循環與風速管制；高層建築差異縮短補償則以預測柱與核心筒的彈性、潛變與收縮縮短差，並以標高預抬、延遲接合與監測回饋加以補償為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on self-climbing a complete form and platform set storey by storey on freshly cast walls: anchor strength, hydraulic lifting, floor cycles and wind control; Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings centres on predicting elastic, creep and shrinkage shortening differences between columns and cores and compensating with level corrections, delayed connections and monitoring feedback, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「樓層循環時程」與「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到高層建築差異縮短補償，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「以振弦式應變計量測縮短」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Floor cycle time” and “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Measuring shortening with vibrating-wire gauges", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 高層建築液壓爬模施工
history.text: 自爬模板由傳統的吊升跳模發展而來，把模板、平台與油壓頂升機構整合成不依賴塔吊的系統。PERI 的 ACS 自爬系統型錄把 1994 年的吉隆坡雙子星塔列為早期參考案例；2004 年起興建、2010 年完工的哈里發塔，由 Doka 以 SKE100 自爬系統配合 Top 50 大面積牆模，以 3 天樓層循環完成核心筒與翼牆，並首次使用 Xclimb 60 自爬防護屏。2012 年樂天世界塔核心筒以 132 組 SKE100 爬升，另以自爬單元同步提升混凝土布料機。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: Self-climbing formwork evolved from crane-lifted jump forms by integrating forms, platforms and hydraulic lifting into a system that does not depend on the tower crane. PERI's ACS self-climbing literature lists the Petronas Towers of 1994 among its early references; at Burj Khalifa, completed in 2010, Doka used the SKE100 self-climbing system with Top 50 large-area wall forms to build the core and wing walls on a three-day floor cycle and used the Xclimb 60 self-climbing protection screen for the first time. In 2012 Lotte World Tower's core climbed on 132 SKE100 units, with further self-climbing units lifting the concrete placing booms in step. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
